title: A feedback flag survives a same-day edit that moves its fact and drops after an unrelated later edit
goal: feedback_flags drops a flag whose line no longer holds the fact the report named, also after an edit on the report's own day and after an uncommitted edit; a flag whose fact still sits on its line stays after an unrelated edit of the article, such as a fact appended at the end. Found by the SP-vlfcgmbu review (gaps 3 and 4 on BG-4x5qp2jh): the day comparison keeps same-day shifts and drops every flag on any later commit

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,json,time
n=chr(10);d=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.makedirs(os.path.join(st,'2026-10'))
def w(p,t):

g('init','-q');g('add','.');g('commit','-qm','a')

same_day=flags()
art(['- Fact zz. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]','- Fact zero. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]','- Fact alpha. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]','- Fact beta. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]'])
report(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d',time.gmtime()),na);dirty_today=flags()
r={'unchanged article keeps the flag':base==[na],'same-day committed shift drops it from line %d'%na:same_day is not None and na not in same_day,'uncommitted shift after a report of today drops it':dirty_today is not None and na not in dirty_today}
print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r.values()) else 1)
